newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber weak, latex stable.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber weak, latex stable.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were weak late on Monday, with a surge of fresh enquiries from the U.S. failing to boost sentiment, dealers said.

"The only real demand now comes from the U.S, but it fails to impress the market. The Europeans and the Chinese, however, remained mostly sidelined," one dealer in the central Sumatran city of Jambi said.
Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November were at 55.00-55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.50-55.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.25-54.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Another dealer said there were some fresh enquiries from the United States following previous buying in Padang at 54.50 cents/lb fob Padang on Saturday.

Latex dealers in Medan said latex offer prices for exports would probably stay between 90 to 93 cents/kg, but deals were likely to be done at around 90 cents/kg. Latex for October shipments was last traded at 90 cents/kg fob Medan for Europe.
Dealers said supply was not as tight as had been forecast as recent heavy rains fell mostly during the late afternoon and evening and failed to have an impact on tapping.
